__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Select the existing working Prometheus data source.

title: Service Health and Catalogue
description: Service ownership, dependencies, fresh Up/Down/Unknown checks, history, availability, coverage, certificate expiry, SMART health and HTTP/TLS/DNS diagnostics. Combines the project templates with Blackbox Exporter HTTP Prober revision 1. Catalogue and disk filters are independent of probe filters.

list.name: disk_host
list.label: Disk host
list.description: Filters SMART health only; independent of Probe job, Service and Target.

list.name: probe_interval_s
list.description: Actual Blackbox scrape interval in seconds. Used only for coverage. Also set the status-history Min interval and the Prometheus datasource Scrape interval.

list.name: probe_freshness_s
list.description: Maximum accepted up/probe sample age in seconds, exclusive. Default90 assumes30s scrapes; choose a tolerance longer than normal scrape completion/jitter.

list.name: disk_freshness_s
list.description: Maximum accepted smartctl status/up Prometheus sample age in seconds, exclusive. Default 180 assumes 30s scrapes; adjust for the actual smartctl job interval. Does not measure the exporter cache age.

panels.title: Visible probe checks
panels.description: Checks with a currently queryable up series, including failed scrapes. This is observed monitoring inventory, not proof of complete service coverage. Missing inventory is Unknown/No data.

targets.expr: count(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"})))

panels.title: Failed destination checks
panels.description: Failed destination checks only with fresh probe_success and a fresh successful scrape. Zero alone does not prove every expected check is monitored or known.

targets.expr:
count((
  probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
) == 0)
or (0 * count(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))

panels.title: Unknown probe checks
panels.description: Visible checks with failed scrapes, missing probe_success or samples older than probe_freshness_s (default 90s for 30s scrapes). Missing inventory gives Unknown/No data, not 0.

targets.expr:
count(((
  probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
)
or on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(-1 + 0 * (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))) == -1)
or (0 * count(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))

panels.title: Current probe checks
panels.description: One row per visible probe:1 passed,0 failed,-1 unknown. Known states require successful fresh up and fresh probe_success samples (default<90s). Removed targets eventually disappear; compare with agreed inventory.

targets.expr:
(
  probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
)
or on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(-1 + 0 * (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))

panels.title: Probe status history
panels.description: Sampled probe status at each query step: Up green, Down red, Unknown gray. Freshness is evaluated at each step. Max data points 200 and Min interval 30s coarsen long periods and can miss brief failures. Gaps are not filled.

targets.expr:
(
  probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
)
or on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(-1 + 0 * (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))

panels.title: Successful HTTP probe duration
panels.description: Total successful HTTP probe duration in seconds for modules named http_*. Filtered to fresh successful scrapes/probes. Includes connection/TLS work; failures create gaps. The 1s reference line must be checked against the agreed threshold and loaded ServiceSlow rule.

targets.expr:
(
  probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service",module=~"http_.*"}
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service",module=~"http_.*"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service",module=~"http_.*"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service",module=~"http_.*"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
)

panels.title: Observed probe availability
panels.description: Percentage of recorded probe_success samples that succeeded over the selected period. Missing samples are excluded; visible checks without samples map to Unknown. Historical series can remain after removal. Read with coverage; this is not a service SLO.

targets.expr:
(100 * avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range]))
or on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (-1 + 0 * (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))

panels.title: Probe sample coverage
panels.description: Approximate recorded probe_success samples / expected samples, using probe_interval_s (default 30). Visible checks with no samples in the period show 0. New targets, label changes, monitoring outages and retention reduce coverage; historical removed targets can remain.

targets.expr:
clamp_max(
  100 * count_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range]) / ($__range_s / $probe_interval_s),
  100
)
or on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (0 * (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))

panels.title: HTTPS certificate days remaining
panels.description: Days until the earliest certificate expiry reported by each selected Blackbox probe. Requires a fresh successful scrape and fresh positive expiry metric, not probe_success=1. HTTP-only targets are not applicable. Missing data for an expected HTTPS check requires investigation; compare with the agreed HTTPS inventory. Negative days indicate expiry. Colours: below 3 red, 3 to below 14 orange, 14 or more green.

targets.expr:
(
  (probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} - time()) / 86400
)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} > 0)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(time() - timestamp(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)

panels.title: Host disk SMART health
panels.description: Latest exported overall SMART health: Passed (1), Failed (0), or Unknown when the status is missing, invalid, stale or the exporter scrape failed. Known disks stay visible as Unknown for up to 24h after their last device/status sample. Disk host filters this table independently of the Probe job/Service/Target filters. This is the overall SMART assessment, not a short/long self-test result or its timestamp. Freshness checks apply to Prometheus samples; exporter polling/cache health must be checked separately.

targets.expr:
max by (host, instance, device) (
  (smartctl_device_smart_status{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"} == 0 or smartctl_device_smart_status{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"} == 1)
  and on(job, instance) (up{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"} == 1)
  and on(job, instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"}) < $disk_freshness_s)
  and (time() - timestamp(smartctl_device_smart_status{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"}) < $disk_freshness_s)
)
or on(host, instance, device)
(
  -1 + 0 * max by (host, instance, device) (
    last_over_time(smartctl_device{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"}[24h])
    or last_over_time(smartctl_device_smart_status{job="smartctl",host=~"$disk_host"}[24h])
  )
)

panels.title: Every monitored service
panels.description: Current discovered scrape inventory from up, including failing scrapes. One row per service/host requires complete identity and identical owner/contact/dependencies across checks. Newly discovered targets need a first scrape; removed targets disappear after staleness processing. API exporter rows are collection checks, not guest inventories.

targets.expr: count by (service, host, owner, contact, dependencies) (up)

panels.title: Services with incomplete catalogue metadata
panels.description: Distinct service/host tuples with at least one check missing a required catalogue label. Missing identity labels can merge unrelated checks and undercount services: inspect job/instance/module in Explore. Zero only checks label presence on current up series; placeholders, bad metadata and undiscovered services need manual review. No data or an error requires investigation.

targets.expr: count(count by (service, host) (up{service=""} or up{host=""} or up{owner=""} or up{contact=""} or up{dependencies=""})) or (0 * count(up))

panels.title: Services missing catalogue metadata
panels.description: Current up series missing service, host, owner, contact or dependencies, grouped by service/host. Missing identity labels can merge unrelated checks: inspect job/instance/module in Explore. Checks missing metadata counts incomplete checks, including failing scrapes. Empty/No data is expected only when the top inventory has data and the metadata counter is zero.

targets.expr: count by (service, host) (up{service=""} or up{host=""} or up{owner=""} or up{contact=""} or up{dependencies=""})

panels.description: Current state plus HTTP status, SSL use, certificate days, TLS version and one-minute mean total/DNS duration. Rows join on the full check identity, not just the destination. Status includes TCP checks; HTTP-only fields can be empty. Diagnostic values require fresh samples and a fresh successful scrape; unavailable values are Unknown.

targets.expr:
label_join(((
  probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
  and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
  (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
)
or on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(-1 + 0 * (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job) (count by(job) (probe_success) or count by(job) (up{job="blackbox"}))))), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies")

max by(check_key) (label_join(((probe_http_ssl{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_http_ssl{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s))), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies"))

max by(check_key) (label_join(((
  (probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} - time()) / 86400
)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} > 0)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)
and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies)
(time() - timestamp(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies"))

max by(check_key) (label_join(((probe_http_status_code{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_http_status_code{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)) > 0), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies"))

max by(check_key) (label_join((avg_over_time(probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}[1m]) and (probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s))), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies"))

max by(check_key,version) (label_join(((probe_tls_version_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_tls_version_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s))), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies"))

max by(check_key) (label_join((avg_over_time(probe_dns_lookup_time_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}[1m]) and (probe_dns_lookup_time_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_dns_lookup_time_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s))), "check_key", " | ", "job", "instance", "module", "service", "host", "owner", "contact", "dependencies"))

panels.title: HTTP Probe Overview
HTTP Probe Duration

targets.expr: sum by(job,instance,module,service) ((probe_http_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_http_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s)))

panels.description: Sum of HTTP request phase durations over redirects, per check identity; includes partially completed failed probes. Compare with Successful HTTP probe duration for passed checks.

panels.title: HTTP Probe Phases Duration

targets.expr: (probe_http_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"} == 1) and on(job,instance,module,service,host,owner,contact,dependencies) (time() - timestamp(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s) and (time() - timestamp(probe_http_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",service=~"$service"}) < $probe_freshness_s))

panels.description: Duration of each HTTP request phase, summed over redirects and stacked as in the supplied dashboard. Each repeated row selects one destination; use the legend to distinguish modules if that destination has multiple checks.
